(d) It may help to reframe your marathon plateau the way you’d reframe a temporary dip in server performance: identify what’s adjustable in your training, and let go of metrics you can’t control this season. Keep your focus on the elements you can tweak—like recovery routines or nutrition—rather than replaying the runs that didn’t meet your goals. Just as obsolete hardware can’t be upgraded mid-race, some phases require patience before the next performance leap.

Set manageable goals and tick them off. A series of small accomplishments helps rebuild trust in yourself and creates positive momentum.

Ask: What can this teach me? Sometimes the lesson is about preparation, flexibility, or asking for help — insight you can use going forward.

Get input from trusted people who can highlight both what went well and what could improve. Specific, balanced feedback is more empowering than vague criticism.
